lines.text: Box down, cabbages in. Bucket up, and empty.
Water runs downhill. So we catch it upstream, where it's higher... and let it slide all the way here.

lines.why: stunned, staring at the stream where the cabbage landed

lines.text: The cabbage is fine. The cabbage is... swimming.
Too much water, too fast. Lesson one: open a gate a little at a time.

lines.why: whispered, eyes on the rising box

msgs.text: slow is smooth. smooth is fast

rows.text: so the flume starts upstream, where it is higher
